purpose: Canonical protocol-only golden-wire SCL-assisted physical-trial pin. This exact SHA preserves trusted-SCL DataSet/RCB authority and indexed RCB instance semantics, keeps the proven BRCB direct-RptEna with ResvTms retry-only behavior and URCB Resv-before-RptEna behavior, and allows normal Play to request one explicit one-shot GI only after the InformationReport receiver is registered, RCB activation succeeds, and two RCB readbacks complete. Explicit GI acceptance is now a startup success gate: when GI is rejected the engine fails closed, unregisters the monitor, disables RptEna, and releases any reservation instead of reporting a misleading active monitor with Unknown initial values. The read-only SCL safe-trial path continues to leave GI disabled and performs no RCB writes, DataSet mutation, or hidden discovery fallback. Physical interoperability remains pending exact-head CI plus relay PCAP/value evidence.
